title: Choose the visual world for ĒDUCŌ
question: The roll assigned The Kit. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kit
options.lineage: Japanese shear & tool catalogues (spec sheets, line drawings, model numbers), the kit every barber student is issued
options.thesis: The program sold like a precision instrument: one model, ĒDUCŌ-1000, every spec on the table.
materials: dashed construction geometry from the logo
options.viewport: A catalogue cover: the dashed square/circle/triangle + ĒDUCŌ wordmark huge, one B&W hands-and-shears photo, a spec table (1,000 hrs · CA license · Full-time / Part-time · from 6–7 months) and 'Enroll' as the order button. '/Paradox/' lineage line in PRDX Barbicide blue.
options.risk: Can read cold or product-y if the people (educators, students) don't carry as much weight as the specs.

raised.raise: Every offering leads with its promise and turns over to its spec/instructions (schedule, requirements, cost).
Capped seats are drawn as slots: residency days 2–3 show 10 seat cells, filled or empty.
Enrollment is fixed stations in order: Tour → Apply → Enroll → Start, never a menu.

options.label: Vorkurs
options.lineage: Bauhaus school curriculum (the ĒDUCŌ logo's square/circle/triangle are the Bauhaus shapes)
options.thesis: ĒDUCŌ as a modern Bauhaus: the curriculum wheel is the site.
options.viewport: Curriculum wheel with the three shapes, program at the centre, Enroll beneath.
options.risk: Familiar: Bauhaus pastiche is a well-worn design-school look.

options.label: Seed Packet Rack
options.thesis: Each offering is a packet: painted promise on the front, sowing instructions on the back.
options.viewport: A rack of packets: Licensing, Core Fundamentals, Workshops, Residency.
options.case: Holds clarity (promise/instructions is a great selling grammar) but barbers don't identify with gardening.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Students develop like prints, station by station.
options.case: Their B&W photos fit, but the develop gimmick already belongs to the /Paradox/ redesign.

options.label: Console Dashboard
options.thesis: Programs float as monoliths in fog.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.case: Warm calm, wrong energy for a cutting school.
options.kept: One light source: one action lit per view.

options.label: Versailles Vistas
options.thesis: Axial path from palace to canal.
options.case: Pomp, no relation to the audience.
options.kept: One axial path the visitor follows.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, modern school landing page executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Big photo hero, 'Become a barber', Enroll button, three benefit cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other trade school by design.
